evidence.foliageLogic: 16/16 authored M4 test bodies passed V8 harness on exact committed source after mobile-lattice adjustment; NOT genuine Node.
evidence.foliageCrossLane: 40/40 V8 probes passed against exact :00 and :12 opt-in sources: 32 shape/rotation meshes between 208 and 532 triangles, plus 8 targeting/collision contracts. NOT measured production GPU performance.
evidence.foliagePerformance: Initial fine-detail box unions produced ~1480–4412 mesh triangles. Replaced with 1/8-voxel aligned physical parts and reverified 208–532. Visually inspect genuine Chromium later.

integrationDependencies: Production VoxelWorld.set() rejects IDs greater than 8. Manual integration must expand registry and rendering atomically without changing schema-1 layout.
Existing production mesh/collision is whole-cube only. Core masonry uses full cubes; future shaped pieces depend on :12 shape engine and :00 targeting/collision.
No world placement or live UI wiring is authorized.
Existing Stone 3 and Deepstone 8 remain untouched. Shader-only masonry treatments are not physical blocks.
